Market today: Futures are pointing up, riding on global markets feeling good about US resilience. The real driver for us is the tech/chip sector, which seems to be shrugging off tariffs and AI jitters, with some analysts even calling for a bottom and a rally.

Your holdings: CRWD (SELL, 19.65%), QQQ (SELL, -11.3%), SMH (SELL, -33.62%), SMCI (SELL, -46.88%), SNOW (SELL, -20%), PLTU (SELL, -30.87%), MSFU (SELL, -16.66%), MUU (SELL, -74.64%), SOXL (SELL, -85.75%), SPAL (SELL, -55.71%), QQQI (SELL, -15.53%), SPY (TRIM, -2.41%), METU (TRIM, -23.15%). All your positions are marked SELL or TRIM, indicating they need attention. The leveraged ETFs are particularly deep in the red, and margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on the semiconductor sector's reaction to any news, as it's your biggest concentration. Also, watch for any follow-through on the 'tech rout should bottom soon' sentiment.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your highly concentrated, leveraged tech book in this choppy market.
plays: Consider trimming SPY (TRIM, -2.41%) if it breaks below its stop at 705.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
